title: AI made my stock research faster, not my returns higher
author: Fast-Price3140
selftext:
No question ai has saved me a lot of time when researching stocks. It helps me process information and check claims against different sources, which is useful. I used to spend around two weeks getting familiar with a company. I can now do much of that work in a day with Anvita Mate and spend less time going through reports and more time on potential opportunities. 

But saving time doesn’t always mean making more money.   
Say I believe a stock is worth buying below $50. Even if AI helps me reach that conclusion two weeks earlier, I still have to wait if the price stays at $60. The price doesn’t change and my returns don’t go up just because I finish my research sooner. 

AI could still help me make more money. It might find information I missed, or set a better buying price. The point is whether AI helps you make better decisions.
